title: release-claw-cli

goal.text: Publish a verified claw core and CLI release from exact main source.

requirements.summary: Release only the CLI/core artifact family, preserving repository gates and verifying npm retrieval.
acceptanceCriteria: Selected candidates, source manifests, exact CLI runtime pins and DSH mapping agree with the target CLI base; missing/stale authorized platforms were prepared and frozen before promotion, not silently shipped at an older base.
The selected final-version beta has completed seven days and its artifacts remain unchanged.
npm run verify:release -- --candidate <dir> passes from clean local main at the candidate source revision.
Core, Client and CLI are published from their frozen tarballs in order and retrievable before GitHub push.
The immutable v<version> tag and GitHub Release are verified.

tasks.title: Inspect and classify the CLI release baseline
tasks.detail: Before selecting any beta or formal candidate, read docs/beta-release.md and resolve the target CLI base and authorized families. Run npm run audit:release-versions with --phase beta|release, --artifacts <authorized-families>, and each frozen --candidate when applicable. Show source/candidate/known-public versions and exact CLI pins for all families. A selected platform with a missing/stale candidate needs fresh latest-source preparation and freezing at that base before promotion; never relabel frozen artifacts or publish an older CLI to disguise mismatch. Other platforms are inventory only until scope expansion is authorized. Each new candidate requires its own trial or explicit owner waiver. Select the authorized tested frozen candidate and verify its artifact family, sourceRevision and trial; absent a candidate, use candidate preparation and wait for its own trial or an explicitly recorded owner waiver before publication. Read AGENTS.md and references/artifact.md; inspect branch, remotes, tags, npm latest versions, manifests, lockfile, and every worktree change. Stop if another artifact family is mixed without explicit batch authority.

tasks.title: Select the tested local beta
tasks.detail: Read docs/beta-release.md and select its candidate directory. Preserve the candidate version, source commit and artifacts. If no beta exists, prepare one through beta-claw-kit and wait for its own trial or an explicitly recorded owner waiver before publication. Do not bump, rebuild or repack a tested candidate.

tasks.title: Verify built-in templated skill compatibility
tasks.detail: Review preparation checks and run the read-only npm run check:template-versions if needed. Repairs require a new beta batch; never modify the selected tested artifact.

tasks.title: Verify the CLI release candidate
tasks.detail: Review the beta test results and run npm run verify:release -- --candidate <dir>. Require seven days, unchanged artifacts and clean local main at its recorded source revision. Do not run workspace builds or packing.

tasks.title: Pass the exact-source gate and publish
tasks.detail: Run npm run publish:release -- --candidate <dir>. It rejects remote divergence, publishes exact Core/Client/CLI tarballs, verifies registry retrieval, then pushes source main. Create the immutable v<version> tag and GitHub Release from the candidate source. Never push before npm retrieval succeeds.

tasks.title: Verify npm and GitHub evidence
tasks.detail: Verify all three packages, immutable tag and release targets, clean main == origin/main, and any separately authorized installation refresh. Preserve candidate files through completion.

rules: Inventory every platform, but never publish or prepare an unselected family without explicit authorization. Each selected candidate must align with the target CLI base; fourth segments remain independent.

Formal promotion requires the explicitly selected tested frozen candidate. Preserve its version and hashes; never bump, build, pack or export again. If no tested candidate exists, prepare a new version through beta:prepare and wait for its own trial or an explicitly recorded owner waiver before publication.
Never publish a platform plugin through this skill.
Never stash or discard user work to satisfy a release gate.
Stop at the first failed release boundary.
